headings.usage: Use Manrope for all titles, stat card values, and key navigation elements. Employ tracking-tight for sizes above text-2xl.

body.usage: Use IBM Plex Sans for all body copy, data tables, axis labels, and list items.

typography.hierarchy_rules: Do NOT use generic 'Inter'. Ensure high contrast. Headings should be deeply dark (text-zinc-900) on light backgrounds, and pure white (text-white) on dark backgrounds.

brand.usage: Primary action buttons, active navigation states, chart primary strokes, toggles, and emphasis highlights.

functional_scores.rule: CRITICAL: These functional colors must be strictly preserved for all score pills, badges, and progress indicators indicating SEO/Domain performance.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use crisp, highly controlled shadows. Replace default tailwind shadows with: shadow-[0_2px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] for cards.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp borders (border-zinc-200) on all light-mode cards. No muddy gray transparency.
visual_enhancers.radius: Keep it sharp and professional. Max 8px radius (rounded-md or rounded-lg) on cards and buttons.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid full-screen gradients. Use subtle linear gradients only in Recharts (AreaChart fill) from #18C090 (opacity 0.2) to transparent.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: Use a tight 'Bento' style grid for the dashboard. gap-4 or gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.stat_cards: col-span-1 for 4-column layouts. Display main metric loudly in Manrope, sub-metric in IBM Plex Sans.
grids_and_layouts.tools_grid: Grid of distinct, equal-height interactive cards. Use flex and h-full to ensure they stretch to match their neighbors.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Use generous internal padding for cards (p-6). Never crowd text against borders.

sidebar.logo_lockup: Render the provided emerald logo image alongside the text 'Citetail' in Manrope Bold, white text, text-2xl.
sidebar.active_state: Active items get bg-[#18C090]/10, text-white, and a 2px left-border of #18C090.

stat_cards.hover: Subtle transform -translate-y-[2px] and shadow-md transition-all duration-200.

recent_activity_list.style: Clean list layout. Use the functional_scores palette for the score pills inside the list items.
recent_activity_list.dividers: Use border-b border-zinc-100 between items. No border on the last item.

auth_screen.left_panel: Dark background (#0B0B0F) with the emerald logo, large brand typography ('Stunning Insights for Citetail'), and a subtle glowing radial gradient in #18C090.
auth_screen.right_panel: Crisp white background, center-aligned login form using Shadcn inputs and an emerald primary button.

buttons.primary: bg-[#18C090] text-white hover:bg-[#129E75] rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors.

recharts_area.tooltip: Custom tooltip with white background, sharp border, and Manrope font for the value.

motion_and_interactions.hover: All interactive cards and buttons must have hover states (color shift or subtle -translate-y-1).
motion_and_interactions.framer_motion: Use framer-motion for simple staggered entrance animations on the dashboard grid. `<motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ staggerChildren: 0.1 }}>`

logo.description: Emerald-mint double-chevron stacked arrow logo. Use in Sidebar and Auth screen.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-nav-dashboard', data-testid='stat-card-visibility').

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Replace all instances of the old app name with 'Citetail'.
CRITICAL: Completely remove the old royal blue (#002FA7) accent and replace it with the brand emerald (#18C090) across the entire app.
Preserve the functional score color scale strictly (Green >= 80 to Red < 50). Do not overwrite these with the emerald brand color.
Implement designs using standard React .js files (no .tsx).
Use Tailwind v3 classes. Apply the 'group' and 'peer' classes for nested hover states.
Keep the Recharts tooltips clean with custom content renders matching the app's light theme.
Do NOT use HTML native date/select. Use Shadcn components for all inputs and overlays.
Integrate the logo image URL provided in the media_and_assets section into the dark sidebar header and the Auth screen.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Make the dashboard crisp, dense, and premium.
Never center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Do not use generic assistant emoji icons (🤖🧠💭). Use lucide-react icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
